regime_context: The policy regime is a sequencing campaign: the Fed banks hawkish credibility now while Treasury structurally suppresses front-end yields, holding easing as inflation-gated optionality. The consensus 'coordinated dovish pivot' read diverges from revealed interest — Warsh keeps his inflation mandate first and the market is still priced slightly more dovish than the Fed.
regime_context_zh: 政策体制是一场分阶段推进的行动：美联储当前积累鹰派信誉，财政部则结构性压低前端收益率，将宽松作为以通胀为条件的期权保留。市场共识的“协调转鸽”解读与所揭示的实际利益存在分歧——沃什仍将通胀使命置于首位，而市场定价仍比美联储略微偏鸽。

theses.subject: XLE
theses.thesis: The Iran ceasefire collapse re-primes the energy inflow that already made XLE the top Q1 ETF-flow sector; the oil spike is realized and the admin's re-escalation posture keeps headline risk bid.
theses.thesis_zh: 伊朗停火破裂重新点燃了此前已使XLE成为Q1资金流入最多板块的能源配置；油价飙升已兑现，而政府再度升级的姿态使能源板块持续获得地缘风险溢价。
evidence: Iran/Middle East theater: ceasefire COLLAPSED 7/8, Brent ~$80 intraday
Energy was TOP ETF-inflow sector Q1 2026 on conflict rotation
Recent track record: XLE overweight hit +0.1012
theses.dissent: A rapid de-escalation or Hormuz status-quo confirmation would unwind the risk premium fast, and XLE is explicitly flagged as headline-fragile.
theses.dissent_zh: 若迅速降级或霍尔木兹海峡状况被确认维持常态，风险溢价将快速回落，且XLE本身被明确标记为对新闻高度敏感。

falsifier.text: XLE lags SPY by 5% or more over a 30-day stretch without a new escalation headline
falsifier.text_zh: 在30日窗口内，若无新的升级新闻，XLE落后SPY达到5%或以上

theses.subject: TLT
theses.thesis: Warsh holds the hawkish line with a >70% September hike probability and sticky core PCE; front-end yield suppression is explicit, but long duration bears the inflation-mandate credibility risk.
theses.thesis_zh: 沃什坚守鹰派立场，9月加息概率超过70%且核心PCE粘滞；前端收益率抑制是明确的，但长久期资产承担通胀使命信誉风险。
evidence: CME FedWatch >70% Sept hike probability after Iran strikes
May core PCE +0.3% m/m, 3.4% y/y — highest since Oct-2023
Warsh Sintra: 'prices are too high', withheld forward guidance
Recent track record: TLT underweight hit -0.0719
theses.dissent: If the June labor crack widens into a September payrolls collapse, the data-driven pivot reopens and long duration front-runs the easing path.
theses.dissent_zh: 若6月就业疲软扩大为9月非农数据塌陷，数据驱动的转向将重新开启，长久期资产会提前反映宽松路径。

falsifier.text: TLT outperforms SPY by 3% or more and market-implied end-2026 fed funds falls below 3.8%
falsifier.text_zh: TLT跑赢SPY达3%或以上，且市场隐含的2026年底联邦基金利率跌破3.8%

theses.subject: SMH
theses.thesis: The advanced-chip tariff and the China de-risking mandate fund the domestic semiconductor onshoring bid; the SCOTUS strike-down did not unwind the tariff-protection premium, contingent on a clean Section 301 handoff.
theses.thesis_zh: 先进芯片关税与中国去风险化要求为国内半导体本土化提供资金支持；最高法院的否决并未消除关税保护溢价，前提是301条款的替换能顺利完成。
evidence: China tech-war theater: onshoring bid persists contingent on Section 301 handoff
25% advanced-chip tariff stays in force (open prediction)
Recent track record: SMH overweight hit +0.0138
theses.dissent: A messy Section 301 replacement or a broader China tech truce that trims the tariff-protection premium would undercut the onshoring bid.
theses.dissent_zh: 若301条款替换过程混乱，或中美科技休战削弱了关税保护溢价，本土化配置逻辑将受到冲击。

falsifier.text: SMH lags SPY by 5% or Section 301 replacement is postponed past the 60-day mark
falsifier.text_zh: SMH落后SPY达5%，或301条款替换被推迟超过60天

theses.subject: KBE
theses.thesis: Regional banks sit in the crossfire of a hawkish Fed and Treasury's front-end yield suppression; the eSLR-reform channel is still only a proposal, not a rule, and the recent KBE overweight miss shows the trade has not worked in this regime.
theses.thesis_zh: 地区银行处于美联储鹰派立场与财政部前端收益率抑制的夹击中；eSLR改革渠道仍只是提案而非规则，且近期KBE超配的失误表明该交易在此体制下未能奏效。
evidence: Financials/dealer banks rotation theme — FACT mechanism but no rule progress
eSLR-reform only a 'proposed or final rule' open prediction, not yet realized
Recent track record: KBE overweight miss -0.0818
theses.dissent: If a concrete eSLR reform rule lands from a banking regulator, regional banks could re-rate sharply as the funding-cost drag clears.
theses.dissent_zh: 若银行监管机构出台具体的eSLR改革规则，随着资金成本压力解除，地区银行可能大幅重估。

falsifier.text: KBE outperforms SPY by 4% or more following a concrete eSLR rule from a banking regulator
falsifier.text_zh: 在银行监管机构出台具体eSLR规则后，KBE跑赢SPY达4%或以上
